zh: 修正智能計算器官方範例本身都可能無法識別的漏洞：`10萬放11年，最後總共拿41.8萬，真實年化多少` 現在會直接識別為本金 10 萬、年期 11 年、到期總額 41.8 萬，零追問算出等效複合年化約 13.89%。同時新增「所有畫面官方範例 × 簡中／繁中／英文」逐句回歸，避免只測相似句而漏掉使用者真正按到的範例。
產品收益比較由固定的「收租 vs 複利」模板升級為參數化比較：先選兩邊產品類型，再用日常說法填少量條件即可畫曲線。支援儲蓄保險、定期／存款、基金／ETF／股票、買樓收租、債券／派息產品及自訂產品；同類產品亦可直接比較，例如「定期 A 3% vs 定期 B 4%」。
產品比較不再要求一定提供逐年利益表。除了直接年化與每年現金收入，亦可只輸入「第 11 年總值 41.8 萬」或「第 11 年累計收益 31.8 萬」，由系統反推等效增長曲線，再標記翻倍、反超、指定年期價值、差額及觀察期 IRR；真實逐年利益表保留為可選的精確模式。
全面重審分享海報的資訊優先級，統一採用「核心計算結果 + 決定結果的主要輸入」原則。定期存款海報現在明確顯示本金、年利率、存期、計息方式與到期本息；定投、儲蓄目標、派息、開支覆蓋、退休、房貸、分期、個稅、預算、儲蓄保險、港澳台按揭、AA、匯率、油費、健康、高端消費與單位換算等分享海報亦補齊各自的關鍵輸入。
儲蓄保險海報另作密度優化：退保模式會把年繳保費與繳費年期、退保年度、退保總值等核心資料放在同一張海報；領取規劃模式則顯示保費／年期、演示利率、開始領取年度、每年領取、累計領取、期末價值與淨收益，避免把所有明細硬塞到分享圖造成溢出。
普通計算器海報的摘要文字改為依可用空間自動縮放，不再以固定兩行加省略號截掉重要輸入；海報核心欄位在 390×844 手機分享預覽中加入實際布局回歸。
完整 Flutter 回歸 120 項全部通過；針對本次修改檔案的 Dart 靜態分析 0 issues，Web Release 構建成功。
en: Fixed a gap where even an example shown by the Smart Calculator could fail to parse. `100k left for 11 years and 418k received in total — what is the real annualized return?` now resolves directly to 100k principal, 11 years and 418k final value, producing about 13.89% equivalent CAGR with no follow-up questions. Added a regression that checks every visible official example in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English instead of only testing similar phrases.

Upgraded product return comparison from a fixed rental-vs-compound template to parameterized comparison. Pick each product type and describe only a few return assumptions in normal language. Savings insurance, time deposits, funds/ETFs/stocks, rental property, bonds/income products and custom products are supported, including same-type comparisons such as Deposit A at 3% vs Deposit B at 4%.

Year-by-year tables are no longer mandatory for ordinary comparisons. Besides direct annual returns and yearly cash income, the app can accept a single observation such as `year 11 total value 418k` or `year 11 cumulative profit 318k`, derive an equivalent growth curve, and mark doubling, crossover, horizon values, gaps and estimated horizon IRR. Real yearly schedules remain available as the optional precision mode.

Audited share posters around one rule: show the core calculation result together with the main inputs that determine it. The Time Deposit poster now explicitly includes principal, annual rate, term, interest basis and maturity value; DCA, goals, dividends, expense coverage, retirement, mortgage, installments, tax, budget, insurance, regional mortgage, split bills, FX, commute cost, health, luxury-cost and unit-conversion posters were audited and supplemented as well.

Rebalanced Savings Insurance poster density. Surrender posters now surface annual premium/payment term, surrender year and surrender value, while payout-plan posters surface premium/term, illustration rate, payout start, annual payout, cumulative payout, final policy value and net gain without overflowing the social poster.

Direct-calculator poster summaries now auto-fit to available space rather than truncating important assumptions with a fixed two-line ellipsis. Added real 390×844 share-preview layout regression for the poster audit.
All 120 Flutter tests pass; targeted Dart analysis for every file changed in this release reports 0 issues, and the Web release build succeeds.
